name: Scroll
tagline: A weekday digest of your Following feed, so you can stop scrolling it yourself
description: It reads your Following timeline in chronological order, deliberately skipping the algorithmic feed, and sends a short weekday rundown of the posts worth your attention: who wrote each, why it matters, and the link. An hour of scrolling becomes a two-minute read. Read-only, and it never engages for you.
author: arouch_serg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
